public_rationale: The sources do not establish all three financial assertions on comparable measures and dates. A possible slowdown in combined revenue does not demonstrate that each company slowed. Contemporary reporting also describes acceleration at OpenAI. Anthropic's relative position and the two growth trends require separate tests.
limitations: High growth and slowing growth can occur together.
A higher revenue run rate does not establish faster current growth.
Later operating results cannot settle an observation about the pre-post period.
The accessible sources lack a complete reconciled time series.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI's revenue growth is slowing, and Anthropic, itself slowing, has outpaced it.

statement.excerpt: Its revenues are slowing, its competitor (and there’s really only one) has outpaced it (all while slowing itself), and its CEO is one of the single-worst spokespeople in history.

our_interpretation: Assess the financial proposition supplied for grading; the remark about the CEO is an opinion outside that proposition.
Read slowing as a declining revenue growth rate, not falling revenue.
Identify the competitor as Anthropic from the surrounding text.
Use the latest year-to-date reporting window through August 18, 2026, because the surrounding discussion compares revenue developments during 2026.
The surrounding discussion uses annualized revenue. Test that measure separately from realized quarterly or annual revenue.
Read outpaced primarily as Anthropic overtaking OpenAI in revenue run rate. Faster percentage growth is an alternative reading.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable observations show declining growth rates for both companies during the relevant recent intervals, and Anthropic exceeds OpenAI on a consistently measured revenue run rate.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable observations establish accelerating recent growth for either company, or show that Anthropic has not overtaken OpenAI on the specified measure. Merely showing that revenue rose does not contradict slowing growth.

evidence.excerpt: Accounting can't explain the entire $25 billion Anthropic-OpenAI gap
evidence.explanation: This later comparison suggests that accounting differences need not erase Anthropic's lead. It cannot independently establish the August position or either company's growth trend.

evidence.excerpt: Its core consumer business continues to grow, too.
evidence.locator: Episode description, final sentences before the guest list
evidence.explanation: Bloomberg's accompanying account describes recent acceleration, a material competing account. The passage and reported endpoints do not supply a consistent series sufficient to calculate the claimed slowdown.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: Consistent dated revenue observations for both companies through August 18, with reconciled accounting and enough observations to compare successive growth intervals.
